text:
Artemi Panarin is 35, and he's playing like the best forward on the ice most nights in Los Angeles. The Kings take 61% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, 19 points better than without him, one of the biggest gaps we track. He has 18 points in 16 games, including a four-assist night in the 7-2 rout of San Jose alongside Adrian Kempe.

If anything, he's been unlucky. The Kings have scored 8.3 fewer goals than the chances deserve with him on the ice, which has cost him points, and that usually swings back. A team that's 5-9-2 with a winger this good driving play is a team you'd expect to climb.

He came into the season with 954 career points as an undrafted free agent from St. Petersburg. Evolving-Hockey had him 20th of 401 forwards in wins above replacement last season. Our range: 75 to 104 points.
